title: Frozen August 2026 NERO warning-backtest audit

decision.reason: The archive contains one retrospectively available modelled path, no publication-vintage dimension, no revisions, no uncertainty and no independent outcome labels. It cannot establish what was knowable at each historical release or classify warnings as true or false.

source_lock.product: Nowcast of Employment by Region and Occupation

release_availability.evidence: The archive was first recorded during retrieval. No independently evidenced earlier absence check or exact publisher UTC timestamp is available.
release_availability.next_observation: Before the next planned release, record an automated UTC check showing the archive absent, then record the first UTC check showing it present and retain both response records. Prefer a publisher-signed UTC timestamp when available.

source_lock.licence: CC BY 4.0 International with JSA attribution and stated exclusions

official_methodology.model: Stacked ensemble with supervised machine learning, post-model outlier handling, smoothing, reconciliation and scaling to published Labour Force Survey totals by region and occupation.

v3_documented_holdout_metric.name: Mean Absolute Percentage Error
v3_documented_holdout_metric.limitation: One documented holdout month and aggregate subgroup results test point-estimate error, not warning sensitivity, precision, lead time or downstream crisis detection. Group 2 series were excluded from the v3 comparison.

official_cautions: Estimates are experimental and subject to revision, volatility and error.
Caution is required for smaller series and large movements.
Smoothing may hide short-term fluctuations or rapid changes.
Novel regional employment patterns outside historical data may not be captured.
Occupation or region estimates must not be summed or combined.

series_size_diagnostic.definition: Share of the 88 latest SA4 values in each scoped occupation below 800 employed people.
series_size_diagnostic.why_800: The NERO v3 paper reports that series with a recent average below 800 historically had higher errors and volatility in earlier versions.
series_size_diagnostic.warning: Latest value below 800 is only a size-risk proxy. It does not reproduce JSA group membership, which uses recent average size, applies within Group 1 and is not identified in the public archive.

descriptive_flag_load.purpose: Stress-test naive detector burden inside one frozen vintage. These are not accuracy, causal-effect or false-positive estimates.
descriptive_flag_load.dependence_warning: Rows are serially and spatially dependent. A persistent trend produces repeated flags. Episode-level rates will be required in the shadow rehearsal.

calculation_method.three_consecutive_declines: Current observation and its two preceding monthly changes are each below zero
calculation_method.denominator: Each metric counts only series-months with its required preceding observations. Three consecutive declines require three prior monthly comparisons; no population weighting is applied.
calculation_method.era_split: Assigned from the current reference date, with dates through 2022-11-15 in the negative-control era
calculation_method.rounding: Displayed shares are rounded to six decimal places

pre_negative_control_era.definition: Eligible three-decline reference dates from 2015-12-15 through 2016-08-15, before the declared negative-control window.

negative_control_era.definition: Reference dates from 2016-09-15 through 2022-11-15. This transparent pre-December 2022 split is a GenAI-era placebo window, not an AI-free period and not labelled ground truth.

later_era.definition: Reference dates from 2022-12-15 through 2026-08-15. This is not a treated period because adoption is unobserved.

descriptive_flag_load.interpretation: Naive decline rules would have generated a high observation-month alert load before general-purpose generative AI diffusion. Tight one-month thresholds almost never fire, which is consistent with strong smoothing. Neither result reveals warning accuracy because there are no event labels.

backtest_validity_tests.question: Can the estimate available at each historical release be reconstructed without later data?
backtest_validity_tests.evidence: The archive has date and nsc_emp columns but no publication-vintage, model-version or input-cutoff columns. Only the August 2026 publication is frozen in the repository.

backtest_validity_tests.question: Can first-release estimates be compared with later revisions?
backtest_validity_tests.evidence: No earlier publication vintages or revision deltas are present.

backtest_validity_tests.question: Can the historical path be proven to exclude information unavailable at each date?
backtest_validity_tests.evidence: The current archive does not document per-observation input cutoffs or whether the historical path was regenerated under v3.

backtest_validity_tests.question: Can time to detect a rapid break be estimated?
backtest_validity_tests.evidence: JSA states smoothing may miss rapid changes. The archive has no unsmoothed estimate, shock label or event onset.

backtest_validity_tests.question: Is the prevalence of the target warning event known?
backtest_validity_tests.evidence: No target event has been defined or labelled. Decline frequency is alert load, not event prevalence.

backtest_validity_tests.question: Is a matching independent comparator present?
backtest_validity_tests.evidence: NERO uses LFS, Census, vacancy and other inputs. The archive contains no independent occupation-SA4 outcome.

backtest_validity_tests.question: Can warning lead time be measured from information release to event onset?
backtest_validity_tests.evidence: Reference dates are available, but historical release timestamps and labelled onset dates are not.

backtest_validity_tests.question: Can sensitivity, specificity, precision and false-positive burden be calculated?
backtest_validity_tests.evidence: No independent binary or time-to-event ground truth exists.

backtest_validity_tests.question: Does NERO measure the claimed transition mechanism or crisis outcome?
backtest_validity_tests.evidence: It estimates employment levels. It does not measure AI adoption, work redesign, individual flows, continuity-floor access or agency.

permitted_claims: The frozen archive describes a modelled, smoothed employment path for each separate occupation-SA4 series.
A predeclared rule would have generated a stated descriptive alert load when applied retrospectively to this single vintage.
The current evidence is insufficient to label those historical flags correct or incorrect.
prohibited_claims: A decline flag is an AI warning.
The August archive is a pseudo-real-time vintage panel.
A smoothed employment decline establishes job loss, household hardship or lost agency.
